messages:
alex: Starting a config-only deploy in 10m for routing/batching/timeouts. Will pin routing policy v3.2 for the canary traffic group. No model change. Deploy via deploy-bot now?

deploy-bot: @alex scheduled config-deploy/1768209999 to eng-canary at 2026-11-05T14:00:00Z. Tags: config-only,routing,batching,timeout.

marta: quick ask — what's the canary split and warmup window?

alex: 5% canary for 30m, then 20% for 1h if metrics look good. warmup: 2x small-capacity pods to avoid cold-start spike.

sam: what's changing exactly? small diff helps ops triage.

alex: routing policy: prefer low-latency pool, fallback to standard pool. batching: target_batch_size -> 8 (was 4), max_wait_ms -> 25 (was 40). request timeout -> 22000ms (was 25000ms). rate-limiter floor unchanged.

liz: add a temporary soft cap at tenant-level to prevent noisy-tenant impact? recommend tenant_floor=100rps for the canary window.

jamal: SGTM on soft cap. Also recommend enabling KV-prefix caching for common prefixes for 45m during canary.

alex: adding those. Snippet we pushed to config store:

```yaml
routing_policy: 
  prefer: low-latency-pool
  fallback: standard-pool
batching:
  target_batch_size: 8
  max_wait_ms: 25
timeouts:
  request_ms: 22000
tenant_overrides:
  soft_floor_rps: 100
cache:
  enable_kv_prefix: true
  kv_ttl_min: 45
```

observability-bot: Canary dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/canary-routing?orgId=1&panelId=42 (latency, p95/p99, errors, throughput). Alerting: p95 > 600ms OR error-rate delta > +0.5% -> send to #eng-oncall and pause-deploy.

marta: quick smoke plan? who runs manual test calls?

alex: I'll run the smoke suite and seed a few synthetic tenants to validate batching behavior. @sam will watch traces.

sam: watching. I'll also add a tail-sample of requests to check for increased latency variance.

liz: rollback criteria? define exactly.

alex: rollback if any of: sustained p95 increase > 200ms for 10m, error-rate +1% sustained 10m, or customer-impacting errors > 3 in 15m. Immediate unpin and revert to routing_policy v3.0.

jamal: if we need partial rollback we can reduce canary to 0% and keep the rest pinned off. Plan acknowledged.

observability-bot: Deploy started: config-deploy/1768209999 -> canary. Status: in-progress.

deploy-bot: change-window: 14:00-17:00 UTC. Will auto-complete if metrics stable. Manual unpin allowed by ops: `deploy-bot unpin 1768209999`.

sam: smoke run started (curl tests + 20 short chat gen flows).

alex: smoke looks clean for first 6m. p95 down slightly.

sam: tail-sample shows no tail amplification. monitoring OK.

liz: :thumbsup: proceed to ramp to 20% after 30m if alarms remain clear.

observability-bot: 14:32Z metric note: p95 +12ms, error-rate delta +0.02% -> within thresholds.

alex: ramping to 20% now.

deploy-bot: canary ramped to 20%.

jamal: leaving KV-prefix caching enabled for 45m window.

observability-bot: 15:07Z checkpoint: all clear. No alerts triggered.

marta: tagging release notes: "Config-only: routing policy favoring low-latency pool, batching target increased to 8, reduced max wait to 25ms, request timeout tightened to 22s, tenant soft floor 100rps, temporary KV-prefix caching."

alex: publish release notes and close thread once final 1h stability check passes.

observability-bot: 16:01Z final: stability window passed. No rollback needed. Deploy complete.

deploy-bot: config-deploy/1768209999 -> completed. Pins: routing_policy@v3.2 active on route-canary then auto-unpin at 2026-11-05T17:00:00Z unless extended.

liz: thanks all. Filing a follow-up postmortem note for tomorrow with perf deltas.
